notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Dalakos.

description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Freed from the Real's second activated ability by paying {1}, untapping Dalakos.
